title.zh: 卷八十二 列傳第十二: 耶律隆運 耶律勃古哲 蕭陽阿 武白 蕭常哥 耶律虎古
title.en: Volume 82 Biographies 12: Yelu Longyun, Yelu Boguzhe, Xiao Yanga, Wu Bai, Xiao Changge, Yelu Hugu
title.raw: 卷八十二 列傳第十二: 耶律隆運 耶律勃古哲 蕭陽阿 武白 蕭常哥 耶律虎古 Volume 82 Biographies 12: Yelu Longyun, Yelu Boguzhe, Xiao Yanga, Wu Bai, Xiao Changge, Yelu Hugu

sentences.zh: 耶律隆運

translations.literal: Yelu Longyun
translations.idiomatic: Yelu Longyun

sentences.zh: 〈（德威滌魯制心）〉

translations.literal: (Dewei, Dilu, Zhixin)〉
translations.idiomatic: (Dewei, Dilu, Zhixin)〉

sentences.zh: 耶律勃古哲蕭陽阿武白蕭常哥耶律虎古

translations.literal: Yelu Boguzhe, Xiao Yanga, Wu Bai, Xiao Changge, Yelu Hugu
translations.idiomatic: Yelu Boguzhe, Xiao Yanga, Wu Bai, Xiao Changge, and Yelu Hugu

sentences.zh: 〈（磨魯古）〉

translations.literal: (Morlugu)〉
translations.idiomatic: (Morlugu)〉

sentences.zh: 耶律隆運，本姓韓，名德讓，西南面招討使匡嗣之子也。

translations.literal: Yelu Longyun, originally surnamed Han, named Derang, was the son of the Southwestern Frontier Pacification Commissioner Kuangsi.
translations.idiomatic: Yelu Longyun was born Han Derang, son of Kuangsi, the Southwestern Frontier Pacification Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 統和十九年，賜名德昌；

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year of Tonghe, he was granted the name Dechang;
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year of the Tonghe era, he was granted the name Dechang;

sentences.zh: 二十二年，賜姓耶律；

translations.literal: in the twenty-second year, he was granted the surname Yelu;
translations.idiomatic: in the twenty-second year, the imperial surname Yelu;

sentences.zh: 二十八年，復賜名隆運。

translations.literal: in the twenty-eighth year, he was again granted the name Longyun.
translations.idiomatic: and in the twenty-eighth year, the name Longyun once more.

sentences.zh: 重厚有智略，明治體，喜建功立事。

translations.literal: Deep and grave, possessed of strategy, clear in governing principles, fond of establishing achievements and undertakings.
translations.idiomatic: Steady and weighty in bearing, resourceful in counsel, versed in the principles of governance, and eager to win merit through great undertakings.

sentences.zh: 侍景宗，以謹飭聞，加東頭承奉官，補樞密院通事，轉上京皇城使，遙授彰德軍節度使，代其父匡嗣為上京留守，權知京事，甚有聲。

translations.literal: When attending Emperor Jingzong, he was known for careful discipline; he was promoted to Eastern Head Attendant Officer, appointed Han Chinese Affairs Commissioner of the Privy Council, transferred to Shangjing Imperial City Commissioner, given the honorary post of Zhangde Army Military Commissioner, replaced his father Kuangsi as Shangjing Military Governor with delegated authority over capital affairs—his reputation was considerable.
translations.idiomatic: In service to Emperor Jingzong he won renown for scrupulous conduct. He rose through Eastern Head Attendant Officer and Han Chinese Affairs Commissioner of the Privy Council to Shangjing Imperial City Commissioner, received the honorary title of Zhangde Army Military Commissioner, and succeeded his father Kuangsi as Shangjing Military Governor with full charge of capital affairs—an appointment that brought him wide acclaim.

sentences.zh: 尋復代父守南京，時人榮之。

translations.literal: Before long he again replaced his father in guarding Nanjing; the people of the time took it as an honor.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he again took his father's place as defender of the Southern Capital, to the envy of his contemporaries.

sentences.zh: 宋兵取河東，侵燕，五院糺詳穩奚底、統軍蕭討古等敗歸，宋兵圍城，招脅甚急，人懷二心。

translations.literal: Song troops took Hedong and invaded Yan; the Five Yuan corps detailed commandants Xidi and Grand General Xiaotaogu and others were defeated and returned; Song troops besieged the city, their summons and threats extremely urgent, and people's hearts wavered.
translations.idiomatic: When Song forces seized Hedong and pressed into Yan, the Five Yuan detailed commandants Xidi and Grand General Xiaotaogu were driven back in defeat. The Song army laid siege to the city, its summons and threats pressing hard, and loyalty within the walls began to falter.

sentences.zh: 隆運登城，日夜守禦。

translations.literal: Longyun ascended the walls and defended day and night.
translations.idiomatic: Longyun took the ramparts himself and held the defenses day and night.

sentences.zh: 援軍至，圍解。

translations.literal: When relief troops arrived, the siege was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: Relief arrived and the siege was broken.

sentences.zh: 及戰高梁河，宋兵敗走，隆運邀擊，又破之。

translations.literal: At the battle of Gaoliang River the Song army was defeated and fled; Longyun intercepted them and broke them again.
translations.idiomatic: At Gaoliang River the Song army was routed in flight; Longyun cut off their retreat and shattered them once more.

sentences.zh: 以功拜遼興軍節度使，徵為南院樞密使。

translations.literal: For his merit he was appointed Liaoxing Army Military Commissioner and summoned as Southern Chancellery Privy Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: For these services he was made Liaoxing Army Military Commissioner and summoned to the Southern Chancellery as Privy Councilor.

sentences.zh: 景宗疾大漸，與耶律斜軫俱受顧命，立梁王為帝，皇后為皇太后，稱制。

translations.literal: When Emperor Jingzong fell gravely ill, he and Yelu Xiezhen received the dying command together, enthroned the Prince of Liang as emperor, made the empress dowager, and she assumed regency.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Jingzong fell gravely ill, he and Yelu Xiezhen together received the dying command: they enthroned the Prince of Liang as emperor, made the empress the empress dowager, and she assumed regency.

sentences.zh: 隆運總宿衛事，太后益寵任之。

translations.literal: Longyun took overall charge of palace guard affairs, and the empress dowager favored and trusted him all the more.
translations.idiomatic: Longyun took overall charge of the palace guards, and the empress dowager favored and trusted him all the more.

sentences.zh: 統和元年，加開府儀同三司，兼政事令。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tonghe he was given the additional title Director of the Office with Peerage and made concurrent Administrator of Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of the Tonghe era he was given the additional title Director of the Office with Peerage and made concurrent Administrator of Affairs.

sentences.zh: 四年，宋遣曹彬、米信將十萬眾來侵，隆運從太后出師敗之，加守司空，封楚國公。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, Song sent Cao Bin and Mi Xin with a hundred thousand troops to invade; Longyun accompanied the empress dowager on campaign and defeated them; he was given the additional title Defender of the Minister of Works and enfeoffed as Duke of Chu.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, when Song sent Cao Bin and Mi Xin with a hundred thousand men to invade, Longyun accompanied the empress dowager on campaign and routed them. He received the additional title Defender of the Minister of Works and was enfeoffed as Duke of Chu.

sentences.zh: 師還，與北府宰相室昉共執國政。

translations.literal: When the army returned, together with Northern Chancellery Chancellor Shi Fang he jointly held state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: After the army returned, he and Northern Chancellery Chancellor Shi Fang jointly directed state affairs.

sentences.zh: 上言山西四州數被兵，加以歲饑，宜輕稅賦以來流民，從之。

translations.literal: He memorialized that the four prefectures of Shanxi had repeatedly suffered warfare and, with famine added, taxes and levies should be lightened to draw back displaced people; the proposal was approved.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized that the four Shanxi prefectures had repeatedly suffered warfare and, with famine added, taxes and levies should be lightened to draw back displaced people, and the court approved.

sentences.zh: 六年，太后觀擊鞠，胡裏室突隆運墜馬，命立斬之。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, while the empress dowager watched cuju, Hu Lishi charged out and knocked Longyun from his horse; she ordered him beheaded on the spot.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, while the empress dowager watched a cuju match, Hu Lishi charged out and knocked Longyun from his horse; she ordered him beheaded on the spot.

sentences.zh: 詔率師伐宋，圍沙堆，敵乘夜來襲，隆運嚴軍以待，敗走之，封楚王。

translations.literal: By edict he led troops to campaign against Song and besieged Shadui; the enemy came in a night attack; Longyun kept the army strict and ready, defeated them and put them to flight, and was enfeoffed as Prince of Chu.
translations.idiomatic: Ordered to lead troops against Song, he besieged Shadui. When the enemy attacked by night, Longyun held the army in strict readiness, routed them, and was enfeoffed as Prince of Chu.

sentences.zh: 九年，復言燕人挾奸，茍免賦役，貴族因為囊橐，可遣北院宣徽使趙智戒諭，從之。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he again memorialized that the people of Yan harbored malfeasance, sought to evade taxes and corvée, and the nobility used this as a purse; Northern Chancellery Palace Attendant Commissioner Zhao Zhi could be sent to admonish and instruct them; the proposal was approved.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he again memorialized that people in Yan harbored malfeasance, sought to evade taxes and corvée, and the nobility profited from it; Northern Chancellery Palace Attendant Commissioner Zhao Zhi could be sent to admonish them, and the court approved.

sentences.zh: 十一年，丁母憂，詔強起之。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, when his mother's mourning period began, an edict forcibly recalled him to office.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year, when he entered mourning for his mother, an edict forcibly recalled him to office.

sentences.zh: 明年，室昉致政，以隆運代為北府宰相，仍領樞密使，監修國史，賜興化功臣。

translations.literal: The next year Shi Fang retired from office, and Longyun replaced him as Northern Chancellery Chancellor, still heading the Privy Council, supervising compilation of the national history, and was granted the merit title Xinghua.
translations.idiomatic: The following year Shi Fang retired, and Longyun replaced him as Northern Chancellery Chancellor while retaining the Privy Council, supervising compilation of the national history, and receiving the merit title Xinghua.

sentences.zh: 十二年六月，奏三京諸鞫獄官吏，多因請托，曲加寬貸，或妄行搒掠，乞行禁止。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the twelfth year he memorialized that judicial officers in the three capitals often, through patronage, bent cases to grant undue leniency or recklessly applied beating and plunder, and requested that this be forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the twelfth year he memorialized that judicial officers in the three capitals often, through patronage, bent cases to grant undue leniency or recklessly beat and plunder, and asked that this be forbidden.

sentences.zh: 上可其奏。

translations.literal: The emperor approved the memorial.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved the memorial.

sentences.zh: 又表請任賢去邪，太后喜曰：「進賢輔政，真大臣之職。」

translations.literal: He also memorialized requesting appointment of the worthy and removal of the corrupt; the empress dowager said with pleasure: "To advance the worthy and assist governance is truly the duty of a great minister."
translations.idiomatic: He also memorialized requesting appointment of the worthy and removal of the corrupt. The empress dowager said with pleasure, "To advance the worthy and assist governance is truly the duty of a great minister."

sentences.zh: 優加賜賚。

translations.literal: He was especially favored with gifts and rewards.
translations.idiomatic: He received especially generous gifts and rewards.

sentences.zh: 服闋，加守太保、兼政事令。

translations.literal: When mourning ended, he was given the additional titles Defender of the Grand Mentor and concurrent Administrator of Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: When mourning ended, he received the additional titles Defender of the Grand Mentor and concurrent Administrator of Affairs.

sentences.zh: 會北院樞密使耶律斜軫薨，詔隆運兼之。

translations.literal: When Northern Chancellery Privy Councilor Yelu Xiezhen died, an edict made Longyun hold the post concurrently.
translations.idiomatic: When Northern Chancellery Privy Councilor Yelu Xiezhen died, an edict ordered Longyun to hold the post concurrently.

sentences.zh: 久之，拜大丞相，進王齊，總二樞府事。

translations.literal: Before long he was appointed Grand Chancellor, advanced to Prince of Qi, and took overall charge of both privy councils.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was appointed Grand Chancellor, advanced to Prince of Qi, and took overall charge of both privy councils.

sentences.zh: 以南京、平州歲不登，奏免百姓農器錢，及請平諸郡商賈價，並從之。

translations.literal: Because Nanjing and Pingzhou had poor harvests, he memorialized to exempt the people from the farm-implement levy and requested standardization of merchant prices in the various commanderies; both were approved.
translations.idiomatic: Because Nanjing and Pingzhou had poor harvests, he memorialized to exempt the people from the farm-implement levy and requested standardization of merchant prices in the various commanderies; both were approved.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，從太后南征，及河，許宋成而還。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year he accompanied the empress dowager on the southern campaign; reaching the river, Song sued for peace and the army returned.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year he accompanied the empress dowager on the southern campaign; reaching the river, Song sued for peace and the army withdrew.

sentences.zh: 徙王晉，賜姓，出宮籍，隸橫帳季父房後，乃改賜今名，位親王上，賜田宅及陪葬地。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Prince of Jin, granted the imperial surname, removed from the palace register, attached to the Horizontal-Banner Younger-Father house, then again granted his present name, ranked above the imperial princes, and given fields, residences, and burial land beside the imperial tombs.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Prince of Jin, granted the imperial surname, removed from the palace register, and attached to the Horizontal-Banner Younger-Father house. He was then granted his present name, ranked above the imperial princes, and given fields, residences, and burial land beside the imperial tombs.

sentences.zh: 從伐高麗還，得末疾，帝與後臨視醫藥。

translations.literal: Returning from the campaign against Goryeo, he contracted a terminal illness; the emperor and empress came in person to oversee his medical care.
translations.idiomatic: Returning from the campaign against Goryeo, he contracted a terminal illness; the emperor and empress came in person to oversee his medical care.

sentences.zh: 薨，年七十一。

translations.literal: He died at seventy-one.
translations.idiomatic: He died at seventy-one.

sentences.zh: 贈尚書令，謚文忠，官給葬具，建廟乾陵側。

translations.literal: Posthumously made Grand Preceptor of the Secretariat, given the posthumous title Wenzhong, supplied funeral goods by the state, and a temple was built beside Qianling.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously made Grand Preceptor of the Secretariat, given the posthumous title Wenzhong, supplied state funeral goods, and a temple was built beside Qianling.

sentences.zh: 無子。

translations.literal: He had no sons.
translations.idiomatic: He had no sons.

sentences.zh: 清寧三年，以魏王貼不子耶魯為嗣。

translations.literal: In the third year of Qingning, Tiebu's son Yelu of Prince of Wei was made his heir.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Qingning, Yelu, son of Prince of Wei Tiebu, was made his heir.

sentences.zh: 天祚立，以皇子敖盧斡繼之。

translations.literal: When Tianzuo succeeded, Prince Aoluwo was made his successor.
translations.idiomatic: When Tianzuo succeeded, Prince Aoluwo was made his successor.

sentences.zh: 弟德威，侄制心。

translations.literal: His younger brother was Dewei; his nephew was Zhixin.
translations.idiomatic: His younger brother was Dewei; his nephew was Zhixin.

sentences.zh: 德威，性剛介，善馳射。

translations.literal: Dewei, by nature upright and unyielding, skilled at mounted archery.
translations.idiomatic: Dewei was stern and unbending by nature and excelled at mounted archery.

sentences.zh: 保寧初，歷上京皇城使，儒州防禦使，改北院宣徽使。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Baoning he successively served as Shangjing Imperial City Commissioner and Ruzhou Defense Commissioner, then was changed to Northern Chancellery Palace Attendant Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Baoning era he served as Shangjing Imperial City Commissioner and Ruzhou Defense Commissioner before being appointed Northern Chancellery Palace Attendant Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 乾亨末，丁父喪，強起復職，權西南招討使。

translations.literal: At the end of Qianheng, when he was in mourning for his father he was forcibly recalled to office and served provisionally as Southwestern Pacification Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Near the close of Qianheng he was mourning his father but was pressed back into service and given provisional command as Southwestern Pacification Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 統和初，党項寇邊，一戰卻之。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Tonghe, when the Tangut raided the borderlands, he repelled them in a single battle.
translations.idiomatic: At the opening of Tonghe, when Tangut bands raided the frontier, he drove them off in a single engagement.

sentences.zh: 賜劍許便宜行事，領突呂不、叠剌二糺軍。

translations.literal: He was granted a sword and permitted to act at discretion, commanding the Tielubu and Dilie Corps armies.
translations.idiomatic: He received the grant of a sword and authority to act at discretion, taking command of the Tielubu and Dilie corps armies.

sentences.zh: 以討平稍古葛功，真授招討使。

translations.literal: For merit in suppressing and pacifying Shaoguge, he was formally appointed Pacification Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: For suppressing Shaoguge he was formally confirmed as Pacification Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 夏州李繼遷叛宋內附，德威請納之。

translations.literal: Li Jiqian of Xiazhou rebelled against Song and submitted to Liao; Dewei requested to accept him.
translations.idiomatic: When Li Jiqian of Xiazhou broke with Song and offered allegiance to Liao, Dewei urged that he be received.

sentences.zh: 既得繼遷，諸夷皆從，璽書褒獎。

translations.literal: Once Jiqian was obtained, all the Yi peoples followed; an imperial edict in seal script commended and rewarded him.
translations.idiomatic: Once Jiqian was secured, the frontier peoples followed in turn, and an edict sealed in the imperial script praised and rewarded him.

sentences.zh: 與惕隱耶律善補敗宋將楊繼業，加開府儀同三司、政事門下平章事。

translations.literal: Together with Privy Councilor Yelu Shanbu he defeated the Song general Yang Jiye and was promoted to Director of the Office with Peerage and Acting Administrator of Affairs Below the Gate.
translations.idiomatic: With Privy Councilor Yelu Shanbu he defeated the Song commander Yang Jiye and was raised to Director of the Office with Peerage and Acting Administrator of Affairs Below the Gate.

sentences.zh: 未幾，以山西城邑多陷，奪兵柄。

translations.literal: Before long, because many cities in Shanxi had fallen, his military authority was taken away.
translations.idiomatic: Before long, as many strongholds in Shanxi fell, his command was stripped from him.

sentences.zh: 李繼遷受賂，潛懷二心，奉詔率兵往諭，繼遷托以西征不出，德威至靈州俘掠而還。

translations.literal: Li Jiqian having received bribes secretly harbored divided loyalties; obeying the edict Dewei led troops to admonish him. Jiqian pleaded a western campaign and did not come out; Dewei reached Lingzhou, captured booty, and returned.
translations.idiomatic: Jiqian, having taken bribes, nursed secret disloyalty. Ordered to lead troops and reason with him, Dewei found Jiqian pleading a western campaign and refusing to appear. Dewei marched to Lingzhou, carried off captives and plunder, and returned.

sentences.zh: 年五十五卒，贈兼侍中。

translations.literal: At fifty-five he died; posthumously given concurrent Palace Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: He died at fifty-five and was posthumously made concurrent Palace Attendant.

sentences.zh: 子雱金，終彰國軍節度使。

translations.literal: His son Yunjin ultimately served as Zhangguo Army Military Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: His son Yunjin rose to Zhangguo Army Military Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 二孫：謝十、滌魯。

translations.literal: Two grandsons: Xieshi and Dilu.
translations.idiomatic: He had two grandsons: Xieshi and Dilu.

sentences.zh: 謝十終惕隱。

translations.literal: Xieshi ultimately served as Privy Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: Xieshi ended his career as Privy Councilor.

sentences.zh: 滌魯，字遵寧。

translations.literal: Dilu, style name Zunning.
translations.idiomatic: Dilu, whose style name was Zunning.

sentences.zh: 幼養宮中，授小將軍。

translations.literal: Raised in the palace in youth, he was appointed Junior General.
translations.idiomatic: Raised in the palace as a child, he was appointed Junior General.

sentences.zh: 重熙初，歷北院宣徽使、右林牙、副點檢，拜惕隱，改西北路招討使，封漆水郡王，請減軍籍三千二百八十人。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Chongxi he successively served as Northern Chancellery Palace Attendant Commissioner, Right Linya, and Deputy Chief Inspector; was appointed Privy Councilor; was changed to Northwestern Frontier Pacification Commissioner; was enfeoffed as Prince of Qishui Commandery; and requested reduction of the military register by three thousand two hundred and eighty men.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Chongxi era he served in turn as Northern Chancellery Palace Attendant Commissioner, Right Linya, and Deputy Chief Inspector, was appointed Privy Councilor, transferred to Northwestern Frontier Pacification Commissioner, enfeoffed as Prince of Qishui, and requested a reduction of three thousand two hundred and eighty men from the military register.

sentences.zh: 後以私取回鶻使者獺毛裘，及私取阻卜貢物，事覺，決大杖，削爵免官。

translations.literal: Later, for privately taking an otter-fur coat from a Uyghur envoy and privately taking tribute goods from the Zubu, when the matter came to light he was punished with the great staff, stripped of his title, and dismissed from office.
translations.idiomatic: Later, for privately taking an otter-fur coat from a Uyghur envoy and privately taking Zubu tribute goods, when the matter came to light he was beaten with the great staff, stripped of his title, and dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 俄起為北院宣徽使。

translations.literal: Before long he was forcibly recalled as Northern Chancellery Palace Attendant Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was recalled to office as Northern Chancellery Palace Attendant Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 十九年，改烏古敵烈部都詳穩，尋為東北路詳穩，封混同郡王。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year he was changed to Chief Detailed Commandant of the Ugu and Dilie tribes; soon afterward he became Detailed Commandant of the Northeast Route and was enfeoffed as Prince of Huntong Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year he was made Chief Detailed Commandant of the Ugu and Dilie tribes; soon afterward he became Detailed Commandant of the Northeast Route and was enfeoffed as Prince of Huntong.

sentences.zh: 清寧初，徙王鄧，擢拜南府宰相。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Qingning he was transferred to Prince of Deng and promoted to Southern Chancellery Chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Qingning he was transferred to Prince of Deng and promoted to Southern Chancellery Chancellor.

sentences.zh: 以年老乞骸骨，更王漢。

translations.literal: On grounds of age he requested retirement; his princedom was changed to Han.
translations.idiomatic: On grounds of age he requested retirement, and his title was changed to Prince of Han.

sentences.zh: 大康中薨，年八十。

translations.literal: He died during Dakang at eighty.
translations.idiomatic: He died during the Dakang era at eighty.

sentences.zh: 滌魯神情秀徹，聖宗子視之，興宗待以兄禮，雖貴愈謙。

translations.literal: Dilu had a refined and penetrating spirit; Emperor Shengzong regarded him as a son, and Emperor Xingzong treated him with the courtesy due an elder brother—though exalted he became ever more modest.
translations.idiomatic: Dilu possessed a clear, penetrating grace of manner. Emperor Shengzong treated him as a son, and Emperor Xingzong honored him with the courtesy owed an elder brother; the higher he rose, the more modest he became.

sentences.zh: 初為都點檢，扈從獵黑嶺，獲熊。

translations.literal: Initially he was Chief Inspector; accompanying a hunt on Black Ridge he captured a bear.
translations.idiomatic: He first served as Chief Inspector. On a hunt at Black Ridge in the imperial train he brought down a bear.

sentences.zh: 上因樂飲，謂滌魯曰：「汝有求乎？」

translations.literal: The emperor, taking pleasure in drinking, said to Dilu: "Do you have any request?"
translations.idiomatic: The emperor, merry with wine, said to Dilu: "Do you have any request?"

sentences.zh: 對曰：「臣富貴逾分，不敢他望。

translations.literal: He replied: "Your subject's wealth and honor exceed my station; I dare not look elsewhere.
translations.idiomatic: He answered: "Your subject already enjoys wealth and rank beyond his desert; I dare not ask for more.

sentences.zh: 惟臣叔先朝優遇，身歿之後，不肖子坐罪籍沒，四時之薦享，諸孫中得赦一人以主祭，臣願畢矣。」

translations.literal: Only my uncle received exceptional favor in the former court; after his death his unworthy son was punished and his property confiscated. For the seasonal sacrifices, if one among the grandsons could be pardoned to preside at the rites, your subject's wish would be fulfilled."
translations.idiomatic: Only this: my uncle was favored in the former reign, but after his death his unworthy son was condemned and the family estate confiscated. For the seasonal offerings, if one grandson among them might be pardoned to preside at the ancestral rites, your subject's wish would be complete."

sentences.zh: 詔免籍，復其產。

translations.literal: An edict exempted him from the register and restored his property.
translations.idiomatic: An edict cleared the register and restored the confiscated property.

sentences.zh: 子燕五，官至南京步軍都指揮使。

translations.literal: His son Yanwu rose to Nanjing Infantry Commander-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: His son Yanwu became Nanjing Commander of the Foot Soldiers.

sentences.zh: 制心，小字可汗奴。

translations.literal: Zhixin, childhood name Khan Slave.
translations.idiomatic: Zhixin, whose childhood name was Khan Slave.

sentences.zh: 父德崇，善醫，視人形色，輒決其病，累官至武定軍節度使。

translations.literal: His father Dechong was skilled in medicine; observing a person's complexion he would at once determine the illness, and rose through repeated offices to Wuding Army Military Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: His father Dechong was a physician who could read illness at a glance from a patient's face and bearing; he rose through successive posts to Wuding Army Military Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 制心善調鷹隼。

translations.literal: Zhixin was skilled at training hawks and falcons.
translations.idiomatic: Zhixin excelled at training hawks and falcons.

sentences.zh: 統和中，為歸化州刺史。

translations.literal: During Tonghe he served as Guihua Prefecture prefect.
translations.idiomatic: During the Tonghe era he was made prefect of Guihua.

sentences.zh: 開泰中，拜上京留守，進漢人行宮都部署，封漆水郡王。

translations.literal: During Kaitai he was appointed Shangjing Military Governor, advanced to Commander of the Han Chinese Imperial Palace Detachment, and enfeoffed as Prince of Qishui Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: In the Kaitai era he was appointed Shangjing Military Governor, promoted to Commander of the Han Chinese Imperial Palace Detachment, and enfeoffed as Prince of Qishui.

sentences.zh: 以皇后外弟，恩遇日隆。

translations.literal: As the empress's younger brother by a different mother, imperial favor daily grew.
translations.idiomatic: As the empress's younger brother, his favor at court grew day by day.

sentences.zh: 樞密副使蕭合卓用事，制心奏合卓寡識度，無行檢，上默然。

translations.literal: Deputy Privy Councilor Xiao Hezhuo held power; Zhixin memorialized that Hezhuo lacked breadth of judgment and personal restraint; the emperor was silent.
translations.idiomatic: Deputy Privy Councilor Xiao Hezhuo dominated affairs. Zhixin memorialized that Hezhuo was shallow in judgment and lax in conduct. The emperor said nothing.

sentences.zh: 每內宴歡洽，輒避之。

translations.literal: Whenever inner banquets were merry and intimate, he would avoid them.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever palace banquets grew convivial, he would withdraw.

sentences.zh: 皇后不悅曰：「汝不樂耶？」

translations.literal: The empress was displeased and said: "Are you not pleased?"
translations.idiomatic: The empress, displeased, said: "Are you unhappy?"

sentences.zh: 制心對曰：「寵貴鮮能長保，以是為憂耳！」

translations.literal: Zhixin replied: "Few who receive favor and exalted rank can long preserve them—therefore I am anxious!"
translations.idiomatic: Zhixin answered: "Those who enjoy favor and high rank seldom keep them long—that is what troubles me!"

sentences.zh: 太平中，歷中京留守、惕隱、南京留守，徙王燕，遷南院大王。

translations.literal: During Taiping he successively served as Zhongjing Military Governor, Privy Councilor, and Nanjing Military Governor, was transferred to Prince of Yan, and moved to Southern Chancellery Grand Prince.
translations.idiomatic: In the Taiping era he served in turn as Zhongjing Military Governor, Privy Councilor, and Nanjing Military Governor, was transferred to Prince of Yan, and was promoted to Grand Prince of the Southern Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 或勸制心奉佛，對曰：「吾不知佛法，惟心無私，則近之矣。」

translations.literal: Some urged Zhixin to embrace Buddhism; he replied: "I do not know the Buddhist Law; only that when the heart is without selfishness, one draws near to it."
translations.idiomatic: Some urged Zhixin to take up Buddhism. He replied: "I do not know the Buddhist teachings; only that when the heart is without selfishness, one draws near to them."

sentences.zh: 一日，沐浴更衣而臥，家人聞絲竹之聲，怪而入視，則已逝矣。

translations.literal: One day he bathed, changed clothes, and lay down; his family heard music; startled they entered to look and found he had already departed.
translations.idiomatic: One day he bathed, changed his garments, and lay down. His household heard the sound of pipes and strings; alarmed, they entered and found he had already passed away.

sentences.zh: 年五十三。

translations.literal: He was fifty-three.
translations.idiomatic: He was fifty-three years old.

sentences.zh: 贈政事令，追封陳王。

translations.literal: Posthumously given Administrator of Affairs and retroactively enfeoffed as Prince of Chen.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously made Administrator of Affairs and enfeoffed as Prince of Chen.

sentences.zh: 守上京時，酒禁方嚴，有捕獲私醞者，一飲而盡，笑而不詰。

translations.literal: When guarding Shangjing, the prohibition on wine was then strict; when someone who brewed liquor in secret was captured, he drank it all in one draft, laughed, and did not interrogate.
translations.idiomatic: While he held Shangjing, the ban on wine was strictly enforced. When a man caught brewing in secret was brought before him, Zhixin drained the cup in one draft, laughed, and let the matter drop.

sentences.zh: 卒之日，部民若哀父母。

translations.literal: On the day of his death, the people of his district mourned as for father and mother.
translations.idiomatic: On the day he died, the people under his rule grieved as though they had lost father and mother.

sentences.zh: 耶律勃古哲，字蒲奴隱，六院夷離堇蒲古只之後。

translations.literal: Yelu Boguzhe, style name Punuyin, was a descendant of Chancellery Commissioner Puguzhi of the Six Yuan.
translations.idiomatic: Yelu Boguzhe, whose style name was Punuyin, was a descendant of Puguzhi, Chancellery Commissioner of the Six Yuan.

sentences.zh: 勇悍，善治生。

translations.literal: Brave and fierce, skilled at managing livelihood.
translations.idiomatic: Brave and fierce, he was skilled at managing livelihood.

sentences.zh: 保寧中，為天德軍節度使，歷南京侍衛馬步軍都指揮使。

translations.literal: During Baoning he served as Tiande Army Military Commissioner and successively as Nanjing Palace Guard Cavalry and Infantry Commander-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: During Baoning he served as Tiande Army Military Commissioner and then as Nanjing Commander of the Palace Guard Cavalry and Infantry.

sentences.zh: 以討平党項羌阿理撒米、仆裏鱉米，遷南院大王。

translations.literal: For suppressing and pacifying the Tangut chiefs Ali Sami and Pulibie Mi, he was transferred to Southern Chancellery Grand Prince.
translations.idiomatic: For suppressing the Tangut chiefs Ali Sami and Pulibie Mi, he was promoted to Grand Prince of the Southern Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 聖宗即位，太后稱制，會群臣議軍國事，勃古哲上疏陳便宜數事，稱旨，即日兼領山西路諸州事。

translations.literal: When Emperor Shengzong succeeded, the empress dowager held regency; at a gathering of ministers to deliberate on military and state affairs, Boguzhe submitted a memorial setting forth several expedient measures; it accorded with the imperial intent, and that same day he was given concurrent charge of the western-circuit prefectures of Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Shengzong succeeded and the empress dowager assumed regency, ministers met to deliberate on military and state affairs. Boguzhe submitted a memorial with several expedient proposals; it pleased the throne, and that same day he was given concurrent charge of the western-circuit prefectures of Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 統和四年，宋將曹彬等侵燕，勃古哲擊之甚力，賜輸忠保節致主功臣，總知山西五州。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Tonghe, when Song generals led by Cao Bin invaded Yan, Boguzhe struck them with great force; he was granted the merit title of Loyal Submission, Integrity Preservation, and Sovereign Service, and given overall charge of the five Shanxi prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Tonghe, when Song generals led by Cao Bin invaded Yan, Boguzhe struck them hard. He received the merit title of Loyal Submission, Integrity Preservation, and Sovereign Service and was given overall charge of the five Shanxi prefectures.

sentences.zh: 會有告勃古哲曲法虐民者，按之有狀，以大杖決之。

translations.literal: When someone reported that Boguzhe had bent the law and abused the people, investigation found grounds; he was punished with the great staff.
translations.idiomatic: When someone reported that Boguzhe had bent the law and abused the people, investigation found grounds, and he was beaten with the great staff.

sentences.zh: 八年，為南京統軍使，卒。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he became Nanjing Grand General and died.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he became Nanjing Grand General and died.

sentences.zh: 子爻裏，官至詳穩。

translations.literal: His son Yaoli ultimately rose to detailed commandant.
translations.idiomatic: His son Yaoli rose to detailed commandant.

sentences.zh: 蕭陽阿，字稍隱。

translations.literal: Xiao Yanga, style name Shaoyin.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Yanga, whose style name was Shaoyin.

sentences.zh: 端毅簡嚴，識遼、漢字，通天文、相法。

translations.literal: Upright, resolute, concise, and stern, he knew Khitan and Chinese characters and was versed in astronomy and physiognomy.
translations.idiomatic: Upright, resolute, concise, and stern, he knew Khitan and Chinese script and was versed in astronomy and physiognomy.

sentences.zh: 父卒，自五蕃部親挽喪車至奚王嶺，人稱其孝。

translations.literal: When his father died, he personally drew the funeral cart from the Five Fan tribes to Xiwang Ridge; people praised his filial piety.
translations.idiomatic: When his father died, he personally drew the funeral cart from the Five Fan tribes to Xiwang Ridge, and people praised his filial devotion.

sentences.zh: 年十九，為本班郎君。

translations.literal: At nineteen he became an attendant of his corps.
translations.idiomatic: At nineteen he became an attendant of his corps.

sentences.zh: 歷鐵林、鐵鷂、大鷹三軍詳穩。

translations.literal: He successively served as detailed commandant of the Iron Forest, Iron Hawk, and Great Hawk armies.
translations.idiomatic: He served in turn as detailed commandant of the Iron Forest, Iron Hawk, and Great Hawk armies.

sentences.zh: 乾統元年，由烏古敵烈部屯田太保為易州刺史。

translations.literal: In the first year of Qiantong he went from Grand Guardian of the Ugu and Dilie Tribal Garrisons to prefect of Yi Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Qiantong he went from Grand Guardian of the Ugu and Dilie tribal garrisons to prefect of Yi Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 幸臣劉彥良嘗以事至州，怙寵恣橫，為陽阿所沮。

translations.literal: The favored minister Liu Yanliang once came to the prefecture on business and, relying on favor, acted wantonly; Yanga blocked him.
translations.idiomatic: The favored minister Liu Yanliang once came to the prefecture on business and, relying on imperial favor, acted wantonly; Yanga blocked him.

sentences.zh: 彥良歸，妄加毀訾，尋遣人代陽阿。

translations.literal: Yanliang returned and slandered him without cause; before long someone was sent to replace Yanga.
translations.idiomatic: Yanliang returned and slandered him without cause; before long an envoy was sent to replace Yanga.

sentences.zh: 州民千餘詣闕請留，即日授武安州觀察使。

translations.literal: More than a thousand people of the prefecture went to court requesting that he remain; that same day he was appointed Observation Commissioner of Wu'an Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: More than a thousand people of the prefecture went to court asking that he remain, and that same day he was appointed Observation Commissioner of Wu'an Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 歷烏古涅裏、順義、彰信等軍節度使，權知東北路統軍使事。

translations.literal: He successively served as military commissioner of the Wugu Nieli, Shunyi, and Zhangxin armies and was given provisional charge of Northeast Route grand general affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He served in turn as military commissioner of the Wugu Nieli, Shunyi, and Zhangxin armies and was given provisional charge of Northeast Route grand general affairs.

sentences.zh: 聞耶律狼不、鐸魯斡等叛，獨引麾下三十餘人追捕之，身被二創，生擒十餘人，送之行在。

translations.literal: Hearing that Yelu Langbu, Duoluwo, and others had rebelled, he alone led more than thirty men under his command in pursuit; he received two wounds, captured more than ten men alive, and sent them to the imperial camp.
translations.idiomatic: Hearing that Yelu Langbu, Duoluwo, and others had rebelled, he alone led a little more than thirty men in pursuit. He received two wounds, captured more than ten men alive, and sent them to the imperial camp.

sentences.zh: 坐不獲首惡，免官。

translations.literal: Because he failed to capture the chief culprit, he was dismissed from office.
translations.idiomatic: Because he failed to capture the chief culprit, he was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 未幾，權南京留守，卒。

translations.literal: Before long he served provisionally as Nanjing Military Governor and died.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he served provisionally as Nanjing Military Governor and died.

sentences.zh: 武白，不知何郡人。

translations.literal: Wu Bai—of what commandery he came is unknown.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Bai was a man of unknown native commandery.

sentences.zh: 為宋國子博士，差知相州，至通利軍，為我軍所俘。

translations.literal: He served as Song National University Erudite, was dispatched to know Xiangzhou, reached Tongli Army, and was captured by our army.
translations.idiomatic: He had been a National University Erudite of Song and was dispatched to administer Xiangzhou. At Tongli Army he was taken prisoner by Liao forces.

sentences.zh: 詔授上京國子博士。

translations.literal: By edict he was appointed Shangjing National University Erudite.
translations.idiomatic: An edict appointed him Shangjing National University Erudite.

sentences.zh: 改臨潢縣令，遷廣德軍節度副使。

translations.literal: He was changed to Linhuang county magistrate and transferred to Guangde Army deputy military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: He was made magistrate of Linhuang county and then promoted to deputy military commissioner of Guangde Army.

sentences.zh: 先是，有訟宰相劉慎行與子婦姚氏私者，有司出其罪。

translations.literal: Earlier, someone sued Chancellor Liu Shenxing and his son's wife Lady Yao for impropriety; the authorities established their guilt.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, a suit had accused Chancellor Liu Shenxing of impropriety with his son's wife, Lady Yao, and the authorities had found grounds for punishment.

sentences.zh: 聖宗詔白鞫之，白正其事。

translations.literal: Emperor Shengzong ordered Bai to try the case; Bai upheld the charge.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Shengzong ordered Bai to hear the case, and Bai upheld the accusation.

sentences.zh: 使高麗還，權中京留守。

translations.literal: Returning from an embassy to Goryeo, he served provisionally as Zhongjing Military Governor.
translations.idiomatic: On his return from an embassy to Goryeo he was given provisional charge as Zhongjing Military Governor.

sentences.zh: 時慎行諸子皆處權要，以白斷百姓分籍事不直，坐左遷。

translations.literal: At that time all of Shenxing's sons held positions of power; because Bai's ruling in the matter of commoners' household registers was deemed unjust, he was demoted by assignment.
translations.idiomatic: Shenxing's sons then held every lever of power. Bai was demoted on the charge that his ruling in a dispute over commoners' household registers had been unjust.

sentences.zh: 未幾，遷尚書左丞，知樞密事，拜遼興軍節度使。

translations.literal: Before long he was transferred to Left Vice Director of the Secretariat, given charge of Privy Council affairs, and appointed Liaoxing Army Military Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was made Left Vice Director of the Secretariat, put in charge of Privy Council affairs, and appointed Liaoxing Army Military Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 致仕，卒。

translations.literal: He retired from office and died.
translations.idiomatic: He retired from office and died.

sentences.zh: 蕭常哥，字胡獨堇，國舅之族。

translations.literal: Xiao Changge, style name Hudujin, was of the imperial maternal uncle's clan.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Changge, whose style name was Hudujin, was of the imperial maternal uncle's clan.

sentences.zh: 祖約直，同政事門下平章事，父實老，累官節度使。

translations.literal: His grandfather Yuezhi was Acting Administrator of Affairs Below the Gate; his father Shilao rose through repeated offices to military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather Yuezhi was Acting Administrator of Affairs Below the Gate; his father Shilao rose through successive posts to military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 常哥魁偉寡言。

translations.literal: Changge was imposing in stature and sparing of speech.
translations.idiomatic: Changge was imposing in stature and sparing of speech.

sentences.zh: 年三十餘，始為祗候郎君。

translations.literal: Only in his thirties did he first become an attendant gentleman.
translations.idiomatic: Not until his thirties did he first become an attendant gentleman.

sentences.zh: 歷本族將軍、松山州刺史。

translations.literal: He successively served as general of his clan and prefect of Songshan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He served in turn as general of his clan and prefect of Songshan.

sentences.zh: 壽隆二年，以女為燕王妃，拜永興宮使。

translations.literal: In the second year of Shoulong, because his daughter became Princess of Yan, he was appointed Commissioner of the Yongxing Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Shoulong, when his daughter became Princess of Yan, he was appointed Commissioner of the Yongxing Palace.

sentences.zh: 及妃生子，為南院宣徽使，尋改漢人行宮都部署。

translations.literal: When the princess bore a son, he became Southern Chancellery Palace Attendant Commissioner and soon was changed to Commander of the Han Chinese Imperial Palace Detachment.
translations.idiomatic: When the princess bore a son, he became Southern Chancellery Palace Attendant Commissioner and soon was made Commander of the Han Chinese Imperial Palace Detachment.

sentences.zh: 乾統初，加太子太師，為國舅詳穩。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Qiantong he was given the additional title Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent and made detailed commandant of the imperial maternal uncle's house.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Qiantong he received the additional title Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent and was made detailed commandant of the imperial maternal uncle's house.

sentences.zh: 二年，改遼興軍節度使，召為北府宰相，以柴冊禮，加兼侍中。

translations.literal: In the second year he was changed to Liaoxing Army Military Commissioner, summoned as Northern Chancellery Chancellor, and because of the imperial succession ceremony given the additional concurrent title Palace Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he was made Liaoxing Army Military Commissioner, summoned as Northern Chancellery Chancellor, and in recognition of his service at the imperial succession ceremony given the additional concurrent title Palace Attendant.

sentences.zh: 天慶元年，致仕，卒，謚曰欽肅。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tianqing he retired from office and died; his posthumous title was Qinsu.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Tianqing he retired from office and died; his posthumous title was Qinsu.

sentences.zh: 耶律虎古，字海鄰，六院夷離堇覿烈之孫。

translations.literal: Yelu Hugu, style name Hailin, was grandson of the Six Yuan Chancellery Commissioner Dilie.
translations.idiomatic: Yelu Hugu, styled Hailin, was grandson of Dilie, Chancellery Commissioner of the Six Yuan.

sentences.zh: 少穎悟，重然諾。

translations.literal: In youth perceptive and quick, he valued keeping his word.
translations.idiomatic: In youth he was quick-witted and held his pledged word sacred.

sentences.zh: 保寧初，補禦盞郎君。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Baoning he was appointed Imperial Cup Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Baoning he entered service as Imperial Cup Attendant.

sentences.zh: 十年，使宋還，以宋取河東之意聞於上。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, returning from an embassy to Song, he reported to the throne Song's intention to take Hedong.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year, on returning from an embassy to Song, he reported to the throne that Song intended to seize Hedong.

sentences.zh: 燕王韓匡嗣曰：「何以知之？」

translations.literal: Prince of Yan Han Kuangsi said: "How do you know this?"
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Yan Han Kuangsi asked: "How do you know?"

sentences.zh: 虎古曰：「諸僭號之國，宋皆並收，惟河東未下。

translations.literal: Hugu said: "Of all the states bearing illegitimate titles, Song has annexed them all; only Hedong is not yet taken.
translations.idiomatic: Hugu replied: "Of every state that bore a rival title, Song has swallowed all—only Hedong remains unconquered.

sentences.zh: 今宋講武習戰，意必在漢。」

translations.literal: Now Song drills troops and practices warfare—the intention must be upon Han."
translations.idiomatic: Now Song drills its armies and rehearses for war—the target can only be the Han north."

sentences.zh: 匡嗣力沮，乃止。

translations.literal: Kuangsi strenuously opposed it, and the matter ceased.
translations.idiomatic: Kuangsi argued strenuously against him, and the court let the warning drop.

sentences.zh: 明年，宋果伐漢。

translations.literal: The next year, Song indeed attacked Han.
translations.idiomatic: The following year Song did indeed invade the Northern Han.

sentences.zh: 帝以虎古能料事，器之，乃曰：「吾與匡嗣慮不及此。」

translations.literal: The emperor, because Hugu could foresee events, valued him, and said: "I and Kuangsi did not consider this far."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor, impressed that Hugu could read events ahead, prized him and said: "Kuangsi and I never saw so far."

sentences.zh: 授涿州刺史。

translations.literal: He was appointed Zhuo Prefecture prefect.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed prefect of Zhuo.

sentences.zh: 統和初，皇太后稱制，召赴京師。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Tonghe, when the empress dowager held regency, he was summoned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: At the opening of Tonghe, when the empress dowager assumed regency, he was summoned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 與韓德讓以事相忤，德讓怒，取護衛所執戎仗擊其腦，卒。

translations.literal: He clashed with Han Dezang over an affair; Dezang in anger took the weapon held by a guard and struck his head—he died.
translations.idiomatic: He fell out with Han Derang over a matter of policy. Derang, enraged, seized a guard's weapon and struck him on the head, killing him outright.

sentences.zh: 子磨魯古。

translations.literal: His son was Morlugu.
translations.idiomatic: His son was Morlugu.

sentences.zh: 磨魯古，字遙隱，有智識，善射。

translations.literal: Morlugu, style name Yaoyin, possessed wisdom and discernment and was skilled at archery.
translations.idiomatic: Morlugu, styled Yaoyin, was intelligent and discerning and a fine archer.

sentences.zh: 統和初，拜南面林牙。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Tonghe he was appointed Southern Chancellery Linya.
translations.idiomatic: At the opening of Tonghe he was made Southern Chancellery Linya.

sentences.zh: 四年，宋侵燕，太后親征。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, Song invaded Yan; the empress dowager personally campaigned.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, when Song invaded Yan, the empress dowager took the field in person.

sentences.zh: 磨魯古為前鋒，手中流矢，拔而復進。

translations.literal: Morlugu served as vanguard; a stray arrow struck his hand—he pulled it out and advanced again.
translations.idiomatic: Morlugu led the vanguard. A stray arrow struck his hand; he pulled it free and pressed on.

sentences.zh: 太后既至，磨魯古以創不能戰，與北府宰相蕭繼先巡邏境上。

translations.literal: After the empress dowager arrived, Morlugu, because of his wound unable to fight, with Northern Chancellery Chancellor Xiaojixian patrolled the borderlands.
translations.idiomatic: Once the empress dowager arrived, Morlugu, too wounded to fight, joined Northern Chancellery Chancellor Xiao Jixian in patrolling the frontier.

sentences.zh: 累遷北院大王。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to Northern Chancellery Grand Prince.
translations.idiomatic: He rose through successive promotions to Grand Prince of the Northern Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 六年，伐宋，為先鋒，與耶律奴瓜破其將李忠吉於定州。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, campaigning against Song as vanguard, together with Yelu Nugua he defeated their general Li Zhongji at Dingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, on the campaign against Song, he again led the vanguard and, with Yelu Nugua, routed the Song commander Li Zhongji at Dingzhou.

sentences.zh: 以疾卒於軍。

translations.literal: He died of illness in the army.
translations.idiomatic: He died of illness in camp.

sentences.zh: 論曰：德讓在統和間，位兼將相，其克敵制勝，進賢輔國，功業茂矣。

translations.literal: Appraisal: Dezang during Tonghe held rank combining general and minister; his defeating enemies and securing victory, advancing the worthy and assisting the state—his achievements were luxuriant.
translations.idiomatic: Appraisal: During Tonghe, Derang held the powers of both general and minister. In defeating enemies, advancing worthy men, and sustaining the state, his achievements were abundant indeed.

sentences.zh: 至賜姓名，王齊、晉，抑有寵於太后而致然歟？

translations.literal: As for the granting of surname and personal name, and enfeoffment as Prince of Qi and Jin—was it perhaps because he enjoyed the empress dowager's favor that it came to this?
translations.idiomatic: As for his grant of the imperial surname and name, and his princedoms of Qi and Jin—was this not rather the fruit of favor from the empress dowager?

sentences.zh: 宗族如德威平党項，滌魯完宗祀，制心不茍合，家聲益振，豈無所自哉！

translations.literal: Among the clan, such as Dewei pacifying the Tangut, Dilu completing the ancestral sacrifices, Zhixin not compromising himself—the family's renown daily rose; was there not a source for this!
translations.idiomatic: Within the clan, Dewei pacified the Tangut, Dilu restored the ancestral rites, and Zhixin refused unworthy compromise—the family name grew ever brighter. Surely such virtue did not spring from nowhere!

sentences.zh: 若勃古之忠，陽阿之孝，武白之直，亦彬彬乎一代之良臣矣。

translations.literal: As for Bogu's loyalty, Yanga's filial piety, and Wu Bai's uprightness—they too were refined exemplars of worthy ministers of an age.
translations.idiomatic: As for Bogu's loyalty, Yanga's filial devotion, and Wu Bai's integrity—they too stand among the finest ministers of their generation.
